category.reason: The target is identified by comparing the locations of Line 11 stations with the current-location marker on the map.

instruction.en: Find the Line 11 metro station closest to my current location on the map.
instruction.zh: 在地图上找到离我最近的 11 号线地铁站。

reference.patch: Replaced the original description of the Longyao Road (龙耀路) station marker with a request for the Line 11 metro station closest to the current location, and added a corresponding Chinese instruction. The original description incorrectly placed the station marker inside a white rectangular box and described the Line 11 badge as a red circle. Extended the groundTruth box’s left boundary from 216 to 210 pixels in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates. Changed category.item from Basic Element to Relative Position and updated category.reason to explain the location comparison.
